# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface

## Application Window

- **Title Bar**: Displays "ASIST-Strategic-Plan-Town-Hall.pptx - LibreOffice Impress"
- **System Tray**: Located at the top-left corner, shows "Activities" and system icons including Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Draw, GIMP, Files, App Store, Help, and Trash.
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons at the top-right corner.
- **Date and Time**: "Oct 22 19:40" displayed in the top-center of the window.
- **Notification Bell Icon**: Located next to the date and time.

## Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help.

## Toolbars

- **Main Toolbar**: Contains icons for common actions including:
  - New document
  - Open document
  - Save document
  - Print
  - Cut, Copy, Paste
  - Undo, Redo
  - Find and Replace
  - Spell Check
  - Grid, Table, Chart, Image, Text Box, Shapes, Connector Lines, Callouts, Arrows, Stars, and other drawing tools
  - Text formatting tools (Bold, Italic, Underline, Font Color, Font Size, etc.)
  - Slide layout and master slide tools
  - Slide show controls

## Sidebar

- **Slides Panel**: Located on the left side of the window, displays thumbnails of all slides in the presentation.
  - Slide 1: "ASIST STRATEGIC PLANNING TOWN HALL MEETING"
  - Slide 2: Blank slide (currently selected)
  - Slide 3: "AGENDA"
  - Slide 4: "BACKGROUND"
  - Slide 5: "WHY STRATEGIC PLANNING?"
  - Slide 6: "HOW DID WE GET HERE?"
  - Slide 7: "WHAT DO WE NEED FROM YOU?"
  - Slide 8: "DISCUSSING THE STRATEGIC PLAN"
  - Slide 9: "5 STRATEGIC DIRECTIONS"
  - Slide 10: (Thumbnail not fully visible)
- **Slide Number Indicator**: "Slide 2 of 19" at the bottom-left corner.

## Main Workspace

- **Slide Canvas**: Large white area in the center of the window where the current slide is displayed.
  - Currently, a blank slide is shown.
  - A watermark or logo at the bottom-center: "asis&t" in red, with "Association for Information Science and Technology" in smaller text below it.

## Properties Panel

- **Panel Title**: "Properties"
- **Slide Properties Section**:
  - **Format**: "Widescreen" (dropdown menu)
  - **Orientation**: "Landscape" (dropdown menu)
  - **Background**: "None" (dropdown menu) with "Insert Image..." button below it
  - **Master Slide**: "Title Slide" (dropdown menu)
  - **Master Background**: Checkbox selected
  - **Master Objects**: Checkbox selected
  - **Master View**: Button available
- **Layouts Section**:
  - **Section Header**: "Layouts"
  - **Layout Options**: Grid of layout thumbnails, with "Blank Slide" selected (highlighted in black with a red border around it).

## Status Bar

- **Slide Information**: "Title Slide" at the bottom-left corner.
- **Position Information**: "-0.52 / -1.87" (coordinates)
- **Size Information**: "0.00 x 0.00" (dimensions)
- **Language Setting**: "English (USA)" at the bottom-right corner.
- **Zoom Control**: "92%" with zoom slider and +/- buttons.

## Pop-up Notification

- **Notification Banner**: Light blue banner at the top of the window.
  - **Message**: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" and "Your donations support our worldwide community."
  - **Buttons**: "Get involved" and "Donate" buttons on the right side.
  - **Close Button**: "X" button on the right side of the banner.

## Additional UI Elements

- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons at the top-right corner.
- **System Tray**: Located at the top-left corner, shows "Activities" and system icons including Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Draw, GIMP, Files, App Store, Help, and Trash.
- **Notification Bell Icon**: Located next to the date and time.
